summary: Candidate is a foundational decorator-based instrumentation skill that overlaps semantically with three existing session_skill peers covering decorator factories, trace decoration, and session initialization. The candidate represents a simpler, more general-purpose decorator pattern that should merge into the factory-based approach (453f771d) as the canonical implementation, while the trace-specific (aa70b4ce) and session lifecycle (1aaff1ea) skills remain as complementary downstream consumers. The candidate's @operation/@session decorators are subsumed by the factory pattern's entity-type-specific decorator creation.
